hosted-lossless-delayed-50ms.description: Hosted tcpcc lossless baseline with 50 ms netem on host-to-guest TUN egress; for a hosted sender this delays the ACK path.

tcp_loss_counters.reason: TCP lost/retrans/total_retrans are preserved for native parity analysis; M7.1 gates the configured zero-loss qdisc instead of assuming runtime scheduling cannot trigger TCP recovery.

native_parity.reason: Do not use the GitHub runner host kernel as a substitute for the pinned native Linux 6.18.y reference.
